name: 流变触感 · Viscous Sensory

source_summary.provenance: Design interpretation from inspected local stills and/or the cited makers’ descriptions. Sources: https://futuredeluxe.com/work/kinder-bueno

visual_rules.medium_behavior: 感官材料产品CG，液体、膏体与固体的响应区别清晰，尺度变化可艺术化。
palette_logic: 色彩来自目标材料与允许的配方；环境提供对比，不替换产品固有色。
visual_rules.shape_line_language: 流体界面连续，弯月面、薄缘或拉丝有明确材料归属；固体断面保持目标声明的层次。
texture_material_logic: 每种介质按目标指定黏度、透明度和粗糙度呈现；包覆层厚度与重力方向可读。
光泽属于湿润界面，酥脆或干燥区域保持相应响应；局部气泡或颗粒仅在目标需要时出现。
visual_rules.lighting_logic: 侧逆光读薄缘和厚度，柔反射读连续表面；明暗层次让液体与固体分开。
composition_logic: 选一个材料行为作为视觉主事件；宏观产品与材料内部景观有明确比例转换。
近焦面读接触或断裂，背景简化，让触感信息具有主次。
visual_rules.optics_rendering_logic: 微距焦面沿接触界面或薄缘展开；流动模糊与凝固状态遵循目标动作相位。

inferred_traits: 通过黏度、包覆、断裂或流动，把材料的感官差异讲清。
These rules are a transferable design interpretation, not the source creators’ complete production method.
unknowns: Exact source lens, shader parameters, simulation settings and full frame-by-frame motion are not established by these rules.
Image transfer does not establish temporal stability or final video quality.
transfer_rules: Target identity, material, geometry, function, palette, layout, text and requested medium remain authoritative.
Select compatible visual mechanisms; do not import every motif into every target.
forbidden_transfer: Source product identity, exact packaging, protected marks, source wording and layout coordinates.
不把水、油、巧克力、釉浆或膏体当成同一种流体；不凭空添加成分、营养或性能事实。

prompts: 制作一个原创、无品牌的产品CG纯画面。微距捕捉两段刚分开的状态，断裂的酥脆层与连续黏稠连接形成对比，碎屑少而有明确来源。 一块无品牌的虚构榛果巧克力威化条被分成两段，层状薄威化断面清楚，中间仅有少量缓慢拉开的浓稠巧克力连接。
制作一个原创、无品牌的产品CG纯画面。侧面微距，釉浆与干燥瓷面的接触界线和厚薄变化清楚，下缘一颗即将落下的液滴；碗口椭圆与曲率稳定。 一个无品牌浅口乳白陶瓷碗正在被一条浓稠靛蓝釉浆覆盖外缘，釉浆沿碗壁形成连续薄缘，未覆盖部分仍是干燥哑面。
validation.notes: Two different target scenarios were generated without source-image attachments and independently inspected. Static style transfer passed with recorded limitations. Actual PNGs are 1672x941; exact canvas, some framing/material-scale facts and moving-video behavior are not fully verified. This is not user adoption. See the validation record and separate evidence asset. Prompt entries are the target briefs; exact compiled native prompts and their SHA-256 are retained in the separate evidence asset.

evidence.review: Dry wafer fracture and glossy viscous chocolate remain distinct across matching halves. The connecting membrane is wider than the small-amount intent; viscosity and temperature are not measured.
The blue glossy layer, matte ceramic boundary and hanging drop provide distinct interface cues. The glossy appearance does not establish an unfired slurry or an actual glazing process.
